Job Description

Responsibilities: 1. Process and manage claim submissions efficiently; 2. Analyze claims data to identify trends and patterns; 3. Collaborate with internal teams to optimize claims operations; 4. Generate reports and provide insights to management on claims performance; 5. Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend solutions; 6. Ensure compliance with industry regulations and company policies regarding claims processing.

Qualifications

Bachelors - Business Analytics, Bachelors - Computer Science, Bachelors - Statistics, Masters - Data Science

Certifications

Associate in Claims (AIC) - The Institutes (USA), Chartered Life Underwriter (CLU) - American College, Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (CPCU) - Insurance Institute of America (IIA)

Underwriting, Underwriting Analysis, Underwriting Support
